messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **federal public holidays** that normally create “long weekends” in Canada during 2023.  
(If a holiday falls on a weekend, the following weekday is usually observed, which often extends the weekend.)

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Observed (if needed) | Typical Long‑Weekend Window |
|---------|-------------|----------------------|-----------------------------|
| New Year’s Day | Sunday Jan 1 | Monday Jan 2 | Dec 31 2022 – Jan 2 2023 |
| Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario) | Monday Feb 20 | — | Feb 18–20 |
| Good Friday | Friday Apr 7 | — | Apr 7–9 |
| Victoria Day | Monday May 22 | — | May 21–23 |
| Canada Day | Saturday Jul 1 | Monday Jul 3 | Jul 1–3 |
| Labour Day | Monday Sep 4 | — | Sep 3–5 |
| Thanksgiving | Monday Oct 9 | — | Oct 8–10 |
| Remembrance Day | Friday Nov 11 | — | Nov 10–12 (only in provinces that observe it) |
| Christmas | Monday Dec 25 | — | Dec 24–26 |
| Boxing Day | Tuesday Dec 26 | — | Dec 24–26 (already part of Christmas long weekend) |

> **Note:**  
> • Some holidays (e.g., Family Day, St. Patrick’s Day, Civic Holiday, etc.) are *province‑specific*, so the long‑weekend window may differ depending on where you live.  
> • If a holiday falls on a weekend, the *following* weekday is typically observed, which can extend the weekend (see New Year’s Day and Canada Day above).  

For the most accurate, province‑by‑province schedule, you can consult the Government of Canada’s official holiday calendar or your provincial government’s labour department website.
